sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:55876-Db
Court No. - 9

Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 5586 of 2024
Petitioner :- Anand Dubey And Others

Respondent :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home U.P. Lko. And Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Anil Kumar Maurya
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,Priyanshi Maurya
Hon'ble Vivek Chaudhary,J.
Hon'ble Narendra Kumar Johari,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, learned AGA for the State, Ms. Priyanshi Maurya, learned counsel for the respondent no. 4 and perused the record.

By means of this writ petition, the petitioners have sought quashing of the First Information Report dated 10.5.2024 registered as case Crime/FIR No. 74 of 2024 under Sections 498A, 313, 323, 377,
504, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act at Police Station-Vikas Nagar, District Lucknow.
On 6.8.2024, we had passed the following order:
Anand Dubey And Others vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home U.P. ... on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/130388317/

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: "A short counter affidavit filed on behalf of opposite party no. 4 today is taken on record.

Learned counsel for the petitioners has drawn the attention of this Court towards Annexure-2 of this writ petition, which is an original compromise deed entered into between the petitioners and opposite party no.4.
Accordingly, let the parties to this petition be present before the Senior Registrar of this Court for verification of the said compromise on 9.8.2024.
Learned Senior Registrar of this Court shall verify the said compromise and submit his report on the next date of listing.
List this case on 13.8.2024 along with the report of Senior Registrar of this Court.

Since the parties appear to have compromised the issues amongst themselves, we hereby direct that till the next date of listing, petitioners shall not be arrested in connection with impugned FIR/Case Crime No. 74 of 2024 lodged on 10.5.2024 under Sections 498A, 313, 323, 377, 504, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act registered at P.S. Vikas Nagar, District Lucknow."
The report of the Senior Registrar of this Court dated 9.8.2024 is on record, according to which, he has verified the compromise on the same day i.e. 9.8.2024.
The original compromise is on record which has been annexed as Annexure-2 to the petition.

According to the terms of the compromise,
parties have decided to withdraw all the ca1ses filed by them against each other.

Intent is clear, the informant-Smt. Ankita Dixit, who is a signatory to the compromise, does not want to press the FIR, therefore, we see no reason to allow the investigation to proceed in pursuance to the impugned FIR.
We, accordingly, quash the FIR, all proceedings/investigation which may have been held consequent thereto are also quashed.
The writ petition is, accordingly, allowed.

Learned AGA shall communicate this order to the court concerned as well as the investigating officer.
.

(Narendra Kumar Johari, J.) (Vivek Chaudhary,J.) Order Date :- 13.8.2024 AKK  Anand Dubey And Others vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home U.P. ... on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/130388317/
